verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that https://docs.base44.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a Base44 documentation index. The docs pages are served as .md files, and Base44 also ships a Docs MCP server that lets assistants like Cursor, Claude Desktop and VS Code search the documentation directly. Agent-oriented guidance (installable skills for AI coding agents, a code-defined backend 'easy for AI coding agents') further supports the story. Missing for 10: no independent or community hands-on report of agents actually consuming llms.txt or the Docs MCP successfully, and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt variant.
